records.subject: Peeling exfoliation
records.conditions: Bi2Te3 exfoliation; steered molecular dynamics; compared with pulling and shearing; eight imidazolium-based ionic liquids, 350–550 K
records.quote: In this study, eight different imidazolium-based ionic liquids are evaluated as solvents for the exfoliation and dispersion of Bi2Te3 at temperatures ranging from 350 to 550 K.
context_quotes: Three distinct exfoliation mechanisms are evaluated (pulling, shearing, and peeling) using steered molecular dynamics simulations, and we predict that the peeling mechanism is thermodynamically the most favorable route.
modality_evidence: Three distinct exfoliation mechanisms are evaluated (pulling, shearing, and peeling) using steered molecular dynamics simulations, and we predict that the peeling mechanism is thermodynamically the most favorable route.

records.subject: [Tf2N-]-based ionic liquids
records.quote: In this study, eight different imidazolium-based ionic liquids are evaluated as solvents for the exfoliation and dispersion of Bi2Te3 at temperatures ranging from 350 to 550 K.
context_quotes: Three distinct exfoliation mechanisms are evaluated (pulling, shearing, and peeling) using steered molecular dynamics simulations, and we predict that the peeling mechanism is thermodynamically the most favorable route.

Furthermore, the [Tf2N-]-based ionic liquids are particularly effective at enhancing the exfoliation, and this performance can be correlated to the unique molecular-level solvation structures developed at the Bi2Te3 surfaces.
modality_evidence: Three distinct exfoliation mechanisms are evaluated (pulling, shearing, and peeling) using steered molecular dynamics simulations, and we predict that the peeling mechanism is thermodynamically the most favorable route.
